scope.goal: Deliver Issue #206 S2 as one evidence-bound multi-hop upgrade operation.
scope.target: Compose the merged S1 resolver with #200/#201 durable package transactions and #203 per-hop remediation, validation, finalization, resume, and rollback semantics.
constraints: Every hop binds an immutable package, manifest, checksum, validator, decision, target-validation receipt, and terminal receipt.
A later hop may start only from the exact finalized checkpoint of the preceding hop and the same unchanged Git HEAD.
Resume rejects route, matrix, hop, package, decision, receipt, authority, or target-state drift.
Rollback restores only the active unfinalized hop to the last finalized consistent checkpoint and never claims reversal of already finalized hops.
No mixed provenance, skipped owner decision, fabricated validator execution, or direct semantic-cutover bypass is accepted.
non_goals: Create a tag or Release or publish assets/packages

architecture_decisions: Reuse the S1 selected route as the sole route authority.
Reuse single-hop transaction and finalization evidence instead of creating weaker parallel receipts.
Treat each finalized hop as an immutable checkpoint; route rollback applies only to the active unfinalized hop.
user_constraints: Use one Issue #206 and one workflow across S1, S2, and S3.
S2 is deferred with Refs #206 and keeps #206 open.
Use full-recommended delegation with at most two concurrent workers and no #207 role claim before #207 integrates.

role_execution_records.scope: Read-only mapping of exact S1, package transaction, remediation, finalization, resume, rollback, and fixture surfaces.
Truthful S2 state-machine and shared API implementation under root integration ownership.

steps: Map shared route, per-hop transaction, finalization, checkpoint, resume, and rollback boundaries.
Implement a sealed route transaction and later-hop exact-checkpoint admission.
Add focused positive and fail-closed multi-hop GWTs.
Run fresh exact-head independent audit and hosted admission.
Deliver one deferred PR and retain Issue #206 open for S3.
validation: isolated package projection and source governance
execution.commit_checkpoint: One deferred S2 PR using Refs #206; Issue remains open for S3.
deferred_items: S3 v0.14.0 source candidate and terminal closure
